query: Y'all got any jeans in a slim fit? Fair warning, I'm a skeptic till I see it (I'll double check the fit myself, don't worry), but I'm willing to be proven wrong. And I want a pair y'all actually have on hand, not one that's just listed on a website somewhere (I've chased those trails before, ended up at a dead end). Price ceiling is 1050 cts, nothing over (yes, every penny counts for me), since student loans ain't gonna pay themselves. Snag last time, y'all: the tag number matched mine, but the pair hung all wrong on me (returning them cost gas money). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Not climbing that switchback twice, since I'm a broke student. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

rules: Only pick items physically in stock, not web-only listings.
Send at most 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 moves or tool calls.
If nothing fits, say so plainly without substitutes.
